purpose: T96: hourly momentum-reversal economics and settlement-window contamination on the expanded hourly PIT cohort. Prior results under test: benchmark v2 intraday cells mom_1h rho=-0.035 and mom_4h rho=-0.047 (both FDR-passing and placebo-clear; negative sign = reversal, i.e. strong down-moves followed by positive 4h forward returns); settlement v1 (T93) found the post-settlement dip is the post half of a settlement-centered weak window (+/-2h around the settlement instant = cycle hours 0-1 and 6-7). Questions: (1) is the mom_4h reversal economically meaningful net of 5bps/side taker plus scheduled funding over the 4h hold, or sub-fee noise; (2) does the reversal strengthen inside high rv_pct terciles or inside negative-funding regimes (T94 share_pos rule); (3) does excluding the +/-2h settlement window move the benchmark key cells funding_pct / mom_4h / taker_pct (Spearman on 4h fwd) enough to change any verdict. Measurement only - no fitting, no trading, no profitability claims.

cohort.label: label.forward_return_bps (perp_forward_mark_return_up_25bps_4h_gross; numeric bps present on all 17960 records)
cohort.scores: per-asset trailing-90-record mid-rank percentiles (benchmark v2 convention); eval rows require i >= ILOOKBACK+MOM4_LAG = 94 with complete momentum windows -> 17,490 eval rows

prior_results.settlement_weak_window: cycle hours 0-1 (post) and 6-7 (pre), ~0/negative mean 4h fwd vs +3.7..+5.7bps mid-cycle (T93)

arms.A1_reversal_economics: mom_4h score bottom quintile (<=0.20, strongest relative down-moves) -> next-4h mean gross fwd bps vs the remaining rows; symmetric top-quintile (>=0.80) and mom_1h pair. Net-of-cost: 5bps/side taker (10bps round trip) plus scheduled funding cashflow when a settlement lands inside the 4h hold (benchmark v2 convention: last_funding_rate*1e4 bps iff 0 <= ns_until_next_funding_settlement <= 4h; pro-rata fallback on the 20 null-distance records). Long side pays funding, short side receives it. Honest tradability flag vs fees. Per-asset table for the mom_4h bottom-quintile arm.
arms.A2_reversal_conditioning: interaction of the mom_4h reversal with rv_pct terciles (trailing-90 mid-rank pct of realized_vol_24h, edges 1/3 and 2/3) and with the funding-sign regime (share_pos = fraction of trailing-90 records with last_funding_rate > 0, current record excluded; positive if >0.6, negative if <0.4, mixed otherwise - T94 convention). Per cell: n, Spearman rho of mom_4h score vs fwd, and bottom-quintile vs rest Welch tilt.
arms.A3_settlement_contamination: recompute the benchmark v2 key cells (funding_pct, mom_4h, taker_pct Spearman of score vs 4h fwd) on the full 17,490-row eval set and on the subset EXCLUDING bars within +/-2h of a settlement. Exclusion rule: pre side = ns_until_next_funding_settlement <= 2h (7.2e12 ns); post side = distance >= 6h (2.16e13 ns); for the 20 null-distance records fall back to decision_ms mod 28_800_000 >= 21_600_000 (pre) / < 7_200_000 (post). On this cohort the rule selects exactly cycle hours {0,1,6,7} (~49.8% of rows). Report rho/t/p/n both ways, within-asset label-shuffle placebo rhos (3 deterministic seeds), BH-FDR over each 3-cell family, per-cell verdict flips, and parity vs stored benchmark v2 rhos.
arms.A4_verdicts: computed honest verdicts: (a) is the hourly reversal economically meaningful or sub-fee noise; (b) does conditioning strengthen it; (c) does settlement-window exclusion change any cell verdict.

statistics.welch: Welch two-sample t, normal-approx two-sided p (same convention as financial_signal_regime_v1 / funding_timing_v1 / settlement_v1); min n=10 per side; approx 80%-power MDE reported per contrast
statistics.spearman: mid-rank Spearman rho with normal-approx t two-sided p (benchmark v1/v2 convention); min n=10
statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR alpha=0.05 computed separately per family: A1 (4 contrasts), A2 (6 contrasts), A3-full (3 cells), A3-clean (3 cells) - no cross-family pooling
statistics.placebo: labels shuffled within asset, 3 deterministic LCG seeds (17, 73, 991); placebo_clear = |rho| > max(0.02, max|placebo rho|) (benchmark v2 verdict rule)
caveats: 4h forward labels on 1h bars overlap ~4x -> positive autocorrelation; Welch/Spearman treat rows as independent so p-values are nominal/optimistic
cross-asset bars sharing a timestamp are correlated through the common market factor; pooled n overstates effective sample size
overlapping 4h trades in A1 are not independent round trips; total_net_bps is an accounting sum, not an executable equity curve
settlement exclusion removes ~50% of eval rows, so A3 compares a restricted mid-cycle subsample - rho changes reflect both contamination removal and regime selection
